feature: Shadow and glow keys: distance, direction, colour, opacity
summary: A shadow's distance, direction, colour and opacity, and a glow's colour and opacity, now take keys like their size, so a title can lift off the page or a glow can warm from blue to orange over a clip.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default. The walk is shadow-distance-keys-walk.

try.do: Open a recording, put the playhead at 0:01, press T, click on the picture and type a title, then press Command-Return.
In Properties, click Animate a property and pick Shadow distance under Effects.
Type 2 into the Shadow distance box and press Return.
Move the playhead to 0:03, type 30 into Shadow distance and press Return.
Step the playhead back to 0:02 and read the value and the diamond.
Go to the start and press Space to play it through.
Pick Shadow color from Animate a property, then at a later moment change the shadow's colour in the Effects list.
Right-click a key on the Shadow distance lane and choose an ease.

evaluate: Does the title read as lifting off the page as the shadow is thrown from 2 to 30?
Is a black shadow on a dark recording strong enough to see the lift, or should keying distance also raise the shadow's opacity?
Are Shadow distance, direction, color and opacity the names you would look for in Animate a property?
Does changing a keyed shadow colour in the Effects list at a second moment feel like it adds a key, the way the canvas does for position?
rough: A typed title already has two shadows, and Add Effect puts a third at the bottom. Every shadow key moves only the first one, so a shadow you add yourself cannot be keyed yet: task keys-on-a-layer-with-several-shadows-move-the-sh.
The walk keys the title's own shadow rather than adding a Drop Shadow first, because of the line above: task keys-on-a-layer-with-several-shadows-move-the-sh.
On this dark recording a black shadow at 30 is subtle; on a light picture it is plain. Nothing was changed for it.
A title lasts three seconds from where it is typed, so a key at 0:03 on a title typed at 0:00 falls on its last frame and the title is gone. The walk types the title at 0:01.
The app goes further than the mock here: the video mock lists only Shadow size under Effects, and this adds four more shadow values and two glow values.
Animate a property now lists 12 values for a title instead of 8, so Shadow color and Shadow opacity sit below the fold of the picker until you scroll or type in Find a property.
A glow's softness and a shadow's Size (spread) still cannot take keys.
